so101_pick_rb_mixed.task: Pick up the striped ball from the bowl of red and blue balls, uncovering it first if it is buried, and return to the start position
so101_pick_rb_mixed.label: RED/BLUE BOWL - striped ball visible or buried

so101_give_hand.task: Hold the ball above the open palm, and when a second hand joins to form a bowl drop the ball into it, then return to the start position
so101_give_hand.label: GIVE - one palm, second hand joins = drop

so101_pick_blue_ball.task: Pick up the blue ball from the bowl and return to the start position
so101_pick_blue_ball.label: BLUE BALL - visible

so101_pick_buried_ball.task: Find the buried blue ball in the bowl, uncover it, pick it up and return to the start position
so101_pick_buried_ball.label: BURIED BALL

so101_pick_ball.task: Pick up the ball and put it in the box
so101_pick_ball.label: BALL INTO BOX
